notes.title: 1.5.2 Clean Up
notes.content:
Hi everyone! There were a few issues with the transition to 1.5 which have now been updated.

[list]
[*]Fixed bug that wipes bird journal progress. (Not retroactive for anyone affected by the bug already.)
[*]Other misc data clean up.
[*]Adjusted feather rewards from mail. Chances of getting shiny feathers is now higher along with a little more quantity.
[/list]

If you were one of the unfortunate users that got the Bird Journal wipe bug this fix will not bring back your old data. 

We're really sorry about this issue. Of all the data in the game to have this error it's most certainly the worst one. All other data seems to have made the transition safely.

If you are one of the players that have been affected by the bug please send an email to support@superretroduck.com and we'll send you some special goodies to help you build up your journal again.

Also, tweaks to the feather rewards were made. The adjustments are subtle but pick up the pace of collecting. It felt like a needed change now that that mobile versions and cloud syncing have been discontinued. (This was a planned quality of life adjustment that made it into the patch).

Thanks,

-Layden

notes.title: 1.5 Stability Update
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! This is a stability update that fixes a bunch of bugs and other backend things. This includes adjustments to how data is stored and fixes for various other issues. All the achievements are achievable again, so you can 100% the game.

The mobile version of the game will be discontinued soon due to a lack of resources, so we wanted to release a finalized version of Tiny Bird Garden Deluxe. Thank you so much for your support over the years, and thank you so much for playing our game. 

[list]
[*]Cloud services have been removed from the options, as this feature has been discontinued.
[*]The Cloud Saving Achievement has been replaced with the new “Late Birdie” Achievement—so now folks can earn that missing achievement.
[*]Save data has been reformatted to allow copying to new devices.
[*]Bug where NPC items would get stuck has now been fixed.
[*]Lots of other smaller issues/bugs throughout the game have been fixed.
[/list]
Is this the last update to the game? Maybe, maybe not! Thank you again for all the support since 2018. 

Please note, we will still provide stability/bug fixes for any major issues, content updates or not. The two of us really appreciate your patience and support. Thank you!

-Daisy and Layden

notes.title: A Spooky Update! 1.4.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We got a real spooky update for you. This includes 4 new Spooky themed birds, as well as 4 new Spooky Babies too!

We're also offering the Spooky Garden, Toys and Hats at half the feathers during October!

The spooky garden and spooky items have been hard to obtain since they were first introduced to the mobile version 2 years ago. (This was when we had limited edition sets, a feature we have since discontinued.) To be fair to those players who got the sets, the set items have since only been available at high feather costs. However, to celebrate the spooky season we thought it would be cool to make them more accessible to all players for a limited time. This only lasts until our planned November update, so make sure to get them soon!

As well as being a spooky event, this is also a regular update!

[b]New Features[/b]

- 4 New Birds to meet.
- 4 New Babies to raise.
- Rainbob 3rd favorite hat changed to not rare item.
- Bug Fix: Crystal doll hat now correct.
- Bug Fix: Baby bird transparency issue fixed. (Doll hats and various menu areas etc).
- Bug Fix: Start up crashes.
- Other small refinements made throughout the game.

We hope you enjoy the spooky season in your gardens!

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the Cloud Saving features are now ready to use! You can find the new Tiny Bird Cloud features on the Title Screen. The Cloud Features are cross compatible on all platforms and with the new Sync feature you can play on multiple devices at the same time while keeping your core progress.

Sync:
The sync feature allows you to update your data without erasing progress on either device. Just press it once once on each device your using and you will be up to date with all your bird journal and progress. (Please keep in mind that feathers and stackable items do not transfer in sync).

Tiny Bird Bank:
As feathers are no longer transferable through backup, you can now deposit and withdraw from the bank when you need to transfer feathers.

Backup:
The traditional backup feature from Mobile. Save an entire backup of your game that you can download at a later date.

There are also a whole bunch of bug fixes and refinements made throughout the game.

This week we also updated Tiny Bird Garden Mobile to bring it up to date with the Deluxe version. That included the 32 birds which were exclusive to Deluxe and the nursery feature. The mini games and story mode are remaining a deluxe exclusive for the time being!

It's been a wild ride the past couple of months since launch! Thank you for all the kind words and support. Look forward to some extra birdy updates coming this year!

-Daisy and Layden
Super Retro Duck
